text:
maria_growth: kicking off a 2-week 'hypersprint' to surface onboarding friction. plan: a short live webinar + on-demand replay, drop 3 curated prompt templates in-console, and a targeted free-credit nudge for new signups. primary metric: 'first-successful-generation' activation rate. idea is to see if combo of webinar + immediate usable prompts moves activation vs baseline. who can own splits + routing?

ajay_pm: love this. propose 3 arms: (A) webinar + 10 credit nudge + templates preloaded, (B) on-demand replay + 20 credit nudge, (C) control: templates only + 10 credit. can we track activation within 7 days? cohort size target ~1.5k each.

sam_engineer: technically ok. a couple notes: 1) need feature-flag for preloaded templates, 2) watch burst on hosted pool first 48h - set autoscale soft cap. can do experiment tags: exp=hypersprint_03, arm=A/B/C.

liz_content: messaging ideas: short dev-focused webinar headline "Ship LLM features faster: templates to production"; microcopy for nudge: "Try these prompts - free credits included". I'll draft 2 email variants (concise vs explainer). also: provide 3 prompt packs: "quickchat", "summarize->rewrite", "qa-rerank".

noah_ops: reserving 40% extra capacity on dedicated pool for launch window (TZs: NA prime, EU followup). need lead routing rules for attendees who convert: sales for company_size>50 OR ad_hoc-enterprise flag. otherwise keep in growth funnel. also add UTM + experiment param so analytics ties back to exp id.

ajay_pm: routing logic we want: attendees who redeem >50 credits -> sales outreach, else automated 3-day nudge sequence. can we A/B the nudge cadence too? short nudge = 1 email + in-app, long nudge = 3 emails over 7 days.

sam_engineer: yep. quick pseudocode for routing I can push to infra/flow repo:

```
if lead.experiment == "hypersprint_03":
  if lead.company_size > 50 or lead.enterprise_flag == true:
    route_to = "sales"
  elif lead.redeemed_credits >= 50:
    route_to = "sales"
  else:
    route_to = "growth_nudge"
```

noah_ops: also add metric hooks: activation_event, redeemed_credits, time_to_first_token, cost_per_activation tag. we'll need to surface on the marketing dashboard.

maria_growth: timeline: Week 0 (prep): creative + templates + infra flags. Week 1: soft launch to 10% seed audience (holdout control). Week 2: full blast + webinar. Owners: @liz_content (creative), @sam_engineer (infra + flags), @noah_ops (capacity + routing), @ajay_pm (experiment design).

liz_content: I'll post draft email + webinar landing copy by EOD tomorrow. want headline options in thread for quick votes.

ajay_pm: tracking success = lift in 7-day activation rate, lift in avg tokens/use, and downstream retention at 14d. target: +8 pts activation, token cost delta < 15%.

maria_growth: perfect. small checklist: 1) set experiment id and UTMs, 2) create variant landing pages, 3) allocate credit budget (max credits per user = 100), 4) wire up analytics tags. tagging owners above. any blockers?

sam_engineer: one potential blocker: preloading templates requires a migration window. I'll catalog work items today and flag if >1 day effort.

noah_ops: I'll provision capacity and post slots in the runbook. also recommend adding a fallback model route if latency spikes: route to smaller-quantized variant for self-serve.

maria_growth: thanks everyone. quick reactions: :thumbsup: from me. if no objections by noon tomorrow, we execute prep plan. Will follow up with a short checklist doc and the final experiment IDs.
